subtitle: Lesson 10 · Same Data, a Lighter Path

code:
SELECT
    region,
    SUM(quantity) AS units_sold,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders,
    SUM(order_total) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)
      AS avg_order_value
FROM northfield_catalog.northfield_orders_curated
WHERE dt BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-13' AND DATE '2026-09-19'
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY units_sold DESC;
caption: Single table, one week, grouped by region — no joins needed.
